evidence.quote: This panel will focus on the settlement infrastructure for U.S. government securities--a vital component of the Treasury market and one that is undergoing an important transition.
As BNYM becomes the sole provider, we will raise our expectations even higher.
Our focus is on the quality of the services offered--their safety, resilience, and support of the market--and not on the particular mechanism for offering them.
